screens.title: Make a Load event for the data entry form
screens.goal: This part explains why the data entry form must read Global.cs as it opens. Then it makes the Load event.

open.what: A Load event is code that runs by itself the moment a form opens. You made one for the quiz in chapter 7.
open.does: When it works, the code tab is open at frmDataEntry_Load. Its curly brackets are still empty.

screens.title: Why the form must read Global.cs as it opens
screens.done: you have read the picture and the lines under it
screens.goal: Each time the data entry form opens it is brand new and empty, but Global.cs still holds everything.

blocks.p: Take quiz closes the data entry form, and the quiz's Return button opens a new one.

drawn.alt: A brand new empty data entry form on the left. Global.cs on the right still holds the quiz score.
drawn.say: The new data entry form is empty. Global.cs still holds everything.

blocks.p: Every time the data entry form opens, it is brand new and empty. Global.cs still has it all, so the form must ask Global.cs the moment it opens.
Code that runs the moment a form opens is a Load event. You met one in chapter 7.

screens.title: Plan the Load event and make it
screens.done: the code tab is open at frmDataEntry_Load with your cursor between its curly brackets
screens.goal: The Load event switches every panel off, asks Global.cs three questions, then fills the boxes and switches on the right panel.

blocks.p: The Load event does three jobs, in this order.
First, it switches all five panels off. Second, it asks Global.cs three questions.
Third, from the answers, it fills the boxes and switches on the right panel.

screens.title: Ask Global.cs three questions and switch on the right panel
screens.goal: This part asks Global.cs three questions: quiz taken, average worked out, test taken. Each yes fills boxes and switches on a panel.

open.what: The first question has an else for a brand new pupil. The other two have no else.
open.does: When it works, the form shows the details and scores a pupil already has. Only the right panel can be clicked.
